_meta.purpose: The Stratagy mailbox (User Agent) field catalog — the VM twin of the eManager program catalog (voicemail-map.md §2). Drives the read-only User Editor: tab, label, tooltip (VM Manager's wording), type, range, wire location and STATUS. status = confirmed | inferred | unknown. Only `confirmed` fields are ever editable, and only once the VM write path is enabled (P3); everything else renders read-only with a status dot and a reason. Offsets for inferred/unknown fields are deliberately absent — they are Unknown A (voicemail-map §9) and are not guessed.

status_legend.confirmed: read byte-exact from the capture; green dot; editable when writes are enabled
status_legend.inferred: shape known, exact wire offset unverified; amber dot; read-only
status_legend.unknown: not yet readable from the wire; grey dot; shown so the tab is complete
